content.text: No restrictive covenant exists under any phrasing. Re-submitting the compliant finding with the rationale tightened to address the two failed heuristic checks.

input.quote: Each party is responsible for the supervision, direction, and control of its respective personnel. IBM reserves the right to determine the assignment of its personnel.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-recruitment covenant binding Customer. Document-wide searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "engage", "induce", "recruit" and "restrictive covenant" return no such provision, and the two candidate sections are unrelated: § 14.8 Personnel (p0182) deals only with each party's supervision, direction and control of its own personnel, IBM's right to assign its personnel, and IBM's use of Subcontractors and Affiliates; § 14.16 Freedom of Action (p0200) affirmatively confirms that "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others." This is the rule's preferred position ("No non-solicit on Customer"), which is better than the mutual 12-month fallback, so the finding is compliant rather than missing and no redline or counterparty comment is warranted — the absence of the restriction benefits Bluefly and must not be flagged. The deterministic checks for a duration cap of 12 months or less and for a general-solicitation carve-out are non-probative here: both presuppose an existing non-solicit clause, and with no such clause in the document there is nothing for those heuristics to measure. Adding carve-out language would require first importing a restriction on Bluefly that IBM has not sought.
